title: Conceding, Evaluating & Being Ironic
goal: Combine the concessive future, *con lo / para lo … que* and ironic *ni que* to express stance and humour.

items: I can concede a point before countering it with the concessive future (será …, pero …).
I can evaluate expectations and contrasts with agreeing con lo … que and para lo … que.
I can use ironic ¡ni que + imperfect subjunctive! naturally to reject an exaggeration.
